AI agents are everywhere. The data behind them is not ready.

A new report from Box found that while AI agents have gone mainstream in enterprise use, the content infrastructure supporting them has not kept pace.

Think about what that means. Organizations are deploying sophisticated AI agents — but those agents are pulling from fragmented document stores, siloed knowledge bases, and unstructured data that was never designed for machine consumption.

The result: hallucinations, incomplete outputs, and workflows that break at the data layer — not the model layer.

Meanwhile, Google reported processing 3.2 quadrillion tokens per month, up 50x year-over-year. Gemini has over 900 million monthly users. Google launched Gemini Spark, a persistent AI agent that runs continuously in the background.

The agent era is here. The infrastructure era needs to catch up.

For founders and executives, the highest-ROI AI investment right now is not a better model. It is making your organization's content accessible, structured, and agent-ready.

GYanTech AI helps enterprise teams close exactly this gap. Link in bio.
